verdict.rationale: Kick documents MCP and CLI tools that can query transactions, generate reports, and pull 'financial statements' (kick-docs-16, kick-docs-28), and its ledger is a true double-entry system with journal entries and a Chart of Accounts (kick-supp-journal-entries, kick-supp-coa), plus a Google Sheets live-data export (kick-supp-sheets-ai). However, a direct probe found no OpenAPI/Swagger spec (kick-probe-2 — all candidate paths 404), and no documentation explicitly names a 'trial balance' report or a REST API delivering GL data in open file formats (CSV/JSON exports aren't described for GL/TB specifically). Missing for 10: an explicit trial-balance report reference, a documented conventional REST/OpenAPI endpoint, and confirmed open-format (CSV/JSON) export of the full GL/TB rather than only MCP/CLI/Sheets access.
